query: SELECT count(*)::int AS remaining FROM public.tickets t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.contact_id IS NOT NULL AND (t.extra->'assoc_companies' IS NULL OR t.extra->'assoc_companies' IN ('null'::jsonb, '[]'::jsonb)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.contact_companies cc WHERE cc.contact_id=t.contact_id AND cc.is_primary)
